title: Fix bugs in a Rust vector utility module
description: Brownfield Rust dirty_cleanup: fix three intentional bugs in vector utility functions (sum_evens, running_max, dedup). The repo_seed has broken code; the agent must fix all bugs so all tests pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/lib.rs.

Bug 1 — sum_evens: filter condition is inverted.
  Fix: change `x % 2 != 0` to `x % 2 == 0`

Bug 2 — running_max: comparison uses nums[0] instead of cur_max.
  Fix: change `if n > nums[0]` to `if n > cur_max`

Bug 3 — dedup: removes elements equal to NEXT element instead of PREVIOUS.
  Fix: compare with the last element in result:
    if result.last() == Some(&nums[i]) { continue }
    result.push(nums[i]);

All 5 tests must pass.
Run: cargo test
required_artifacts: running_max compares against cur_max not nums[0]
dedup compares against result.last() not the next input element
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
